concepts.name: 04-compact-updraft
concepts.description: Shorter lower tail and a tighter turning radius.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset: a refined variation of the attached Flight Deck "Updraft" logo.
Input image role: the attached logo is the design to evolve. The user likes this exact direction. Stay close to its visual language: sculpted black aerodynamic ribbons, flowing convex and concave edges, a rising upper-right trajectory, long tapered terminals, and a curved white airflow channel. Aviation is implicit in the airfoil geometry, never a literal airplane.
Keep the white square canvas, solid black flat silhouette, generous margins, and the exact centered wordmark "Flight Deck" below the symbol in the same clean bold sans serif. Preserve the reference's high contrast, smooth curves, and wordmark spelling. Fit the entire symbol inside the canvas with ample white space on every side. No gradients, shadows, textures, 3D, mockup objects, extra labels or added colors. No literal aircraft, paper airplanes, bird anatomy, feathers, badges, generic arrows, or monograms.
Create ONE distinctive variation on this sheet, with ONE symbol and ONE wordmark. The variation must be visibly different from the reference in the specific way described below, while recognizably belonging to the same Updraft family.
Variation: COMPACT UPDRAFT. Retain the reference's two-piece construction and rising two-tip silhouette. Redraw the lower hooked ribbon into a tighter, rounder, more compact bend. Shorten its long horizontal lower tail by about half, tuck that terminal inward, and make it flow slightly upward instead of stretching to the right. Bring the two ascending tips slightly closer together. Preserve a clear generous curved airflow channel and the broad upper airfoil. Aim for a cohesive almost-square silhouette, strong enough to read as a small app icon. The top tip should not become a needle. This is the closest refinement of the original, with less trailing flourish and better compactness.
